translation: Koizumi invited Kyon to play a game with him.

Koizumi likes western playing card games and
stuff, doesn't he.
What's a western playing card game?

Any game you play with one of those 52-card
decks with suits. Do you play any?

Yep. Like old maid or sevens. I beat Kyon at
'em!

Why don't you ask to play with Koizumi next
time? He'll be delighted!

I'm glad you're finding more people to play
with.
